title: Piggyback Sketching
content: English illustrator Harry Furniss (1854-1925) related this amusing incident inThe Magazine of Artin 1888.Once while covering a political event in Birmingham, his view of the speaker was blocked by a number of very tall gentlemen.“Although close to him on the platform, I could not, being only five feet two, see over the heads of others when all stood to cheer. I mentioned this fact to my neighbor. ‘Oh, you must not miss this scene!’ he said, and quickly, without ceremony, he had me on his back, his bald head serving as an easel.”----Harry Furniss in Wikipedia
